verses.original: Τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ῥητῶς λέγει ὅτι ἐν ὑστέροις καιροῖς ἀποστήσονταί τινες τῆς πίστεως προσέχοντες πνεύμασιν πλάνοις καὶ διδασκαλίαις δαιμονίων
verses.transliteration: To de pneuma rhētōs legei hoti en hysterois kairois apostēsontai tines tēs pisteōs prosechontes pneumasin planois kai didaskaliais daimoniōn
verses.literal: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons

verses.original: ἐν ὑποκρίσει ψευδολόγων κεκαυστηριασμένων τὴν ἰδίαν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: en hypokrisei pseudologōn kekaustēriasmenōn tēn idian syneidēsin
verses.literal: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars whose consciences are seared with a hot iron

verses.original: κωλυόντων γαμεῖν ἀπέχεσθαι βρωμάτων ἃ ὁ Θεὸς ἔκτισεν εἰς μετάλημψιν μετὰ εὐχαριστίας τοῖς πιστοῖς καὶ ἐπεγνωκόσι τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: kōlyontōn gamein apechesthai brōmatōn ha ho Theos ektisen eis metalēmpsin meta eucharistias tois pistois kai epegnōkosi tēn alētheian
verses.literal: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν κτίσμα Θεοῦ καλόν καὶ οὐδὲν ἀπόβλητον μετὰ εὐχαριστίας λαμβανόμενον
verses.transliteration: hoti pan ktisma Theou kalon kai ouden apoblēton meta eucharistias lambanomenon
verses.literal: For every creation of God is good and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected

verses.original: ἁγιάζεται γὰρ διὰ λόγου Θεοῦ καὶ ἐντεύξεως
verses.transliteration: hagiazetai gar dia logou Theou kai enteuxeōs
verses.literal: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer

verses.original: Ταῦτα ὑποτιθέμενος τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καλὸς ἔσῃ διάκονος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐντρεφόμενος τοῖς λόγοις τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς καλῆς διδασκαλίας ᾗ παρηκολούθηκας
verses.transliteration: Tauta hypotithemenos tois adelphois kalos esē diakonos Christou Iēsou entrephomenos tois logois tēs pisteōs kai tēs kalēs didaskalias hē parēkolouthēkas
verses.literal: By pointing out these things to the brothers you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed

verses.original: Τοὺς δὲ βεβήλους καὶ γραώδεις μύθους παραιτοῦ γύμναζε δὲ σεαυτὸν πρὸς εὐσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: Tous de bebēlous kai graōdeis mythous paraitou gymnaze de seauton pros eusebeian
verses.literal: But reject irreverent silly myths Instead train yourself for godliness

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ σωματικὴ γυμνασία πρὸς ὀλίγον ἐστὶν ὠφέλιμος ἡ δὲ εὐσέβεια πρὸς πάντα ὠφέλιμός ἐστιν ἐπαγγελίαν ἔχουσα ζωῆς τῆς νῦν καὶ τῆς μελλούσης
verses.transliteration: hē gar sōmatikē gymnasia pros oligon estin ōphelimos hē de eusebeia pros panta ōphelimos estin epangelian echousa zōēs tēs nyn kai tēs mellousēs
verses.literal: For physical exercise is of limited value but godliness is valuable in every way holding promise for the present life and for the one to come

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος
verses.transliteration: pistos ho logos kai pasēs apodochēs axios
verses.literal: This is a trustworthy saying worthy of full acceptance

verses.original: Εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ κοπιῶμεν καὶ ἀγωνιζόμεθα ὅτι ἠλπίκαμεν ἐπὶ Θεῷ ζῶντι ὅς ἐστιν Σωτὴρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων μάλιστα πιστῶν
verses.transliteration: Eis touto gar kopiōmen kai agōnizometha hoti ēlpikamen epi Theō zōnti hos estin Sōtēr pantōn anthrōpōn malista pistōn
verses.literal: To this end we labor and strive because we have set our hope on the living God who is the Savior of everyone . . . and especially of those who believe

verses.original: Μηδείς σου τῆς νεότητος καταφρονείτω ἀλλὰ τύπος γίνου τῶν πιστῶν ἐν λόγῳ ἐν ἀναστροφῇ ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἐν πίστει ἐν ἁγνείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Mēdeis sou tēs neotētos kataphroneitō alla typos ginou tōn pistōn en logō en anastrophē en agapē en pistei en hagneia
verses.literal: Let no one despise your youth but set an example for the believers in speech in conduct in love in faith in purity

verses.original: ἕως ἔρχομαι πρόσεχε τῇ ἀναγνώσει τῇ παρακλήσει τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: heōs erchomai proseche tē anagnōsei tē paraklēsei tē didaskalia
verses.literal: Until I come devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture to exhortation and to teaching

verses.original: Μὴ ἀμέλει τοῦ ἐν σοὶ χαρίσματος ὃ ἐδόθη σοι διὰ προφητείας μετὰ ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τοῦ πρεσβυτερίου
verses.transliteration: Mē amelei tou en soi charismatos ho edothē soi dia prophēteias meta epitheseōs tōn cheirōn tou presbyteriou
verses.literal: Do not neglect the gift that is in you which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders

verses.original: ταῦτα μελέτα ἐν τούτοις ἴσθι ἵνα σου ἡ προκοπὴ φανερὰ ᾖ πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: tauta meleta en toutois isthi hina sou hē prokopē phanera ē pasin
verses.literal: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them so that your progress will be evident to all

verses.original: ἔπεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἐπίμενε αὐτοῖς τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν καὶ σεαυτὸν σώσεις καὶ τοὺς ἀκούοντάς σου
verses.transliteration: epeche seautō kai tē didaskalia epimene autois touto gar poiōn kai seauton sōseis kai tous akouontas sou
verses.literal: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching Persevere in these things for by so doing . . . you will save both yourself and those who hear you
